modules.description: Install the versioned shared-core protocol, operation catalog, and provider-free verifier used by every harness adapter.
Install the shared processor, finite goalpost evaluator, independent execution/review routing, provider policy, accounting, activation, rollback, and protocol operations.
Install provider-free task budgets, evidence-gated full-depth fallback, context reuse, bounded rendering, usage accounting, shadow stopping, and rollback-backed per-harness activation.
Install the closed harness manifest, translation-only adapter interface, universal bridge, and reference templates.
Install the provider-free conformance runner, deterministic operation suite, and representative fake harness.
OPTIONAL canonical Hermes OS translation adapter and source-only profile contract; installation does not alter live profiles.
OPTIONAL OpenCode plugin-event adapter; shared-core routing and optimization remain centralized.
OPTIONAL Pi extension-event adapter; shared-core routing and optimization remain centralized.
OPTIONAL Antigravity CLI-event adapter; shared-core policy remains centralized and installation does not activate a live runtime.
OPTIONAL Codex notification adapter; native events remain transport signals and shared-core policy stays centralized.
OPTIONAL Claude Code hook adapter; installation does not edit recipient settings or activate hooks.
OPTIONAL MOA phase-event adapter; the Hermes MOA loop and provider/model policy are not copied.
OPTIONAL Cursor hook adapter and reviewable plugin template; installation does not edit Cursor settings or activate the plugin.
Install empty MemoryWeaver runtime and MCP memory bridge.
Install RAG front-door MCP using recipient-owned corpus paths.
Create local capability bindings; concrete providers and endpoints stay local.
Versioned snapshot of profile template, routing policy, and parity plugin metadata.
Credential-free snapshot of the actual Prime/OMP, Hermes Telegram, auto-learning, maintenance, autoexperiment, backup, and restore implementation.
Render the solo-PC default role; VPS and second-PC roles remain disabled optional expansions.
Public eval subset proving clone parity for code-fix and agentic-file-op only.
OPTIONAL GPU-gated ComfyUI image/video tier (M14). Installs only when preflight finds an NVIDIA GPU; skips-with-note otherwise. Ships reference workflows only - never private models/workflows.
OPTIONAL Hermes-governed Prime Agent and oh-my-pi coding-worker contract. Workers use disposable worktrees and return patches for Hermes to verify and apply.
OPTIONAL daily, weekly, and monthly backup-gated maintenance policy. Analysis is sandbox-only and production changes require human confirmation.
OPTIONAL deny-by-default Telegram connection to the authenticated Hermes gateway.
